record.oneLiner: A duck-billed hadrosaur famous for its long, curved head crest.
record.description: Parasaurolophus was a large hadrosaurid ('duck-billed' dinosaur) from the Late Cretaceous of western North America, over 9 m long. It is known for its long, curved, tube-like cranial crest, likely used for visual display and to produce resonating calls. It could move on two legs or four.

notableFacts.text: Its long, curved, hollow crest may have resonated like a trumpet.
The crest likely served for species and sex recognition and acoustic signalling.
